entities.name: Hunding Gjornersen
entities.description: First leader of the Robaran Mercenaries, a thief scouting the Jamuraan seas; known for using his fists as command.

entities.name: Robaran Mercenaries
entities.description: Dominarian band of thieves later reformed into a mercenary army.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Met Hunding when both were captured by Sand Warriors, in the comic.

events.summary: Hunding quits the Robaran for unknown reasons and Adira Strongheart takes command, reforming the band into a mercenary army.
events.quote: His lieutenant, Adira Strongheart , took command

relations.quote: the first leader of the Dominarian band of thieves known as Robaran Mercenaries
